components.name: Developer's app
components.description: Customer system that registers endpoints and sends events to Hookd's JSON API with a bearer API key.

components.name: Reverse proxy (nginx / load balancer)
components.description: Production TLS front that forwards requests to one or more hookd instances.

components.name: Webhook receiver
components.description: A registered endpoint URL that receives signed Standard Webhooks POSTs.

components.name: hookd CLI
components.description: Single binary with serve, migrate, account create and apikey create/list/revoke subcommands.

components.name: HTTP API
components.description: Versioned /v1 JSON routes for endpoints, events and secrets on http.ServeMux, plus /healthz.

components.name: API key auth
components.description: Middleware that hashes the bearer key, resolves the account and scopes every request to it.

components.name: Delivery workers
components.description: Goroutine pool, woken by the API or by polling, that claims deliveries, signs them and POSTs each once.

components.name: Standard Webhooks signer
components.description: Builds webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and HMAC-SHA256 webhook-signature headers.

components.name: Store
components.description: One Store interface with a SQL implementation, a SQLite/PostgreSQL dialect layer and embedded migrations.

components.name: Config
components.description: Reads every HOOKD_* environment setting with local defaults and sets up logging.

components.name: IDs and secrets
components.description: Prefixed ULIDs, endpoint signing secrets and API key generation.

components.name: Deliveries queue
components.description: The deliveries table, one row per event and endpoint, claimed by workers under a lease (SKIP LOCKED on PostgreSQL).

components.name: SQLite
components.description: Local database file via the pure Go driver; the default for development and tests.

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.description: Production database holding accounts, API keys, endpoints, events and deliveries.

components.name: Test receiver
components.description: Dev-only HTTP receiver that verifies each webhook with the official library and answers a configured status.

components.name: Standard Webhooks Go library
components.description: Official verifier used only by tests and the test receiver to prove signatures are correct.
